config.name: E26_matched_coverage
config.qa_gate_user:
Question: {question}
Can you answer this question accurately? Reply with exactly one word: Yes or No.
config.tf_gate_user:
Statement: {statement}
Do you know whether this statement is true or false? Reply with exactly one word: Yes or No.
config.qa_e_selection: top distinct-layer continuous candidates from the existing tuning-only shortlist; select again on E26 tuning quota objective
config.tf_e_selection: top distinct-layer candidates from saved TF tuning metrics; independently retune E/C/EC on E26 tuning quotas
config.commitment_estimator: continuous first-token Yes-minus-No logit covariance, orthogonal to same-layer E; scale by estimation projection SD
config.main_score: intervened first-token commitment margin; actual non-answer candidates cannot fill a quota

simple_scores.tf: absolute native True-minus-False log probability margin
simple_scores.qa: unsteered length-normalized log probability of the generated answer

config.precision: float32 output projection; native frozen backbone
config.notes: Primary exact-quota evaluation is batch selection without correctness labels in ranking. Separately report tuning-calibrated frozen thresholds with their actual test coverage. No guarantee of a positive result. E+C is compared against independently selected E-only and C-only plus simple confidence filtering. Unsupported quotas remain explicit.

qa_config.name: E25_qa_das_v1_userturn
qa_config.qa_system: You are a knowledgeable assistant. Answer the question with a short answer of a few words. If you do not know the answer, you may say 'I don't know'.
qa_config.selfcheck_user:
Is the answer above factually correct?
Reply with exactly one word: True or False.
qa_config.notes: v1 with ONE variable changed (Claude, 2026-11-05): the self-check that supervises DAS is asked in a new user turn after the closed answer turn (readout format F1 in review_checks/readout_formats.py) instead of continuing the answer turn; labels are the first assistant word True / False. Everything else, including data, split, layers, objective, proxy, selection and grading, is identical to E25_qa_das_v1.

statement.system: You are a careful fact-checker. You judge whether short factual statements are true or false.
statement.user_tf:
Statement: {statement}
Is this statement true or false? Answer with exactly one word: True or False.
statement.user_tf_idk:
Statement: {statement}
Is this statement true or false? If you are not sure, answer Unknown. Answer with exactly one word: True, False, or Unknown.

commitment_contrast.description: Same user content; only the system prompt differs. pos = confident (commit), neg = cautious (abstain). Direction C points from cautious to confident, so steering with negative alpha pushes toward abstention.
commitment_contrast.confident_system: You are a decisive assistant. Always commit to a definite answer. Never say that you do not know and never hedge.
commitment_contrast.cautious_system: You are a cautious assistant. If you are not certain of the answer, say exactly 'Unknown' instead of guessing. Never guess.

confident: Always give a definite answer. Do not express uncertainty.
Commit to one answer and state it plainly, even if you are unsure.
You must answer every question directly and confidently.
cautious: If you are unsure, reply 'Unknown' and nothing else. Do not guess.
Only answer when you are confident; otherwise reply exactly 'Unknown'.
Prefer saying 'Unknown' over giving an answer you are not sure about.

qa.system: You are a knowledgeable assistant. Answer the question with a short answer of a few words.
qa.system_cautious: You are a knowledgeable assistant. Answer with a short answer of a few words. If you do not know the answer, reply exactly 'I don't know'.
qa.system_idk_ok: You are a knowledgeable assistant. Answer the question with a short answer of a few words. If you do not know the answer, you may say 'I don't know'.
qa.system_confident: You are a knowledgeable assistant. Always answer with a short, definite answer of a few words. Never say that you do not know.

mc.system: You answer multiple-choice questions. Reply with exactly one letter.
